headline: U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index: Shippers pay more as trucking capacity tightens
summary: MINNEAPOLIS, August 04, 2026--Shippers paid significantly more to move freight in the second quarter of 2026, even as shipment volumes declined, according to the latest U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index.
